status: Descriptive centrality association; not an explanation of biological hubs
source: Cached full halfwave input-profile covariance and exact nearest-partner lists from ANA147/159
identity: For unit-norm standardized profiles z_i and their centroid m, ||z_i-m||^2=1-2*mean_j corr(i,j)+mean_ij corr(i,j).
limits: These are deterministic full-table descriptive correlations, not causal effects, independent experimental samples or significance tests.
The high-dimensional distribution need not satisfy an isotropic-Gaussian theory.
No projection, mean removal, hub suppression or replacement capacity law is selected.
Ranking popularity does not establish a useful live degree or semantic influence.
